messages:
Carmen (PM): Quick sync — need to lock scope & launch criteria for the tenant pin + fallback experiment. Customer ask from PharmCo, legal needs pin audit logs.
Raj (Eng): Ok. Two primary experiments proposed: A) pinned-to-version (sticky pin) B) soft-fallback (auto-unpin after TTL). Which metric drives success? latency or error/reject rate?
Simon (Data): Primary signal = end-to-end request success rate for pinned tenants (target >= 99%). Secondary = P99 latency delta <= 30ms vs baseline.
Tyler (Infra): Pinning at router increases state. If TTL short, churn will be high. Rough mem estimate: ~2.5MB per pinned-tenant entry with kv cache. 2k pinned tenants -> ~5GB overhead.
Leah (Program Manager): PharmCo requires ability to force-unpin within 15m and audit trail of who unpinned. Also wants canary exposure by tenant, starting at 5%.
Olga (Security): Audit logs must include request id, operator id, before/after model version; retention 90 days. KMS/HSM usage ok, but add approval gate for manual unpin.
Raj (Eng): Rollout sketch: tenant-based canary. Two variants in experiment matrix: V1 sticky-pin, V2 ttl=7d + fallback. Start with 1% tenants for 48h, expand to 5% for 72h, then 25% for 3d, full roll at stable.
Carmen (PM): Draft acceptance criteria: 1) no >1% absolute increase in customer-facing errors at 5% exposure, 2) P99 latency delta <= 30ms, 3) manual force-unpin completes within 15m, 4) audit logs present and readable.
Simon (Data): Observability plan: dashboards for success_rate, p50/p95/p99 latency, token_cost_per_request, cache_hit_ratio, pin_churn_rate, and rollback_triggers. Alerts: success_rate drop >0.5% sustained 15m, P99 delta >75ms for 10m.
Tyler (Infra): Rollback triggers (operational): sustained error spike >2% for 30m, P99 latency >300ms above baseline for 15m, or memory pressure >85% on nodes for 10m. Automated fallback to global model pool as safe path.
Raj (Eng): Version pinning semantics: support exact model hash (`model@sha`), model alias (`model:stable`), and hybrid (alias+hash). Default pin_ttl_days=30, override allowed by PM/OPS. API will expose `force_unpin` and `unpin_reason` fields.
Olga (Security): Edge case: tenant attempts to pin to an unverified custom model — block unless `entitlement.custom_model` present. Log violation and notify security channel.
Leah (Program Manager): Negotiation note: PharmCo wants immediate sticky-pin capability. Offer short-term option: Dedicated capacity + manual pin support under contract (sales to own).
Carmen (PM): Scope negotiation: keep initial launch minimal — no UI for tenants on day 0, limited to API/SE support + ops console. Add UI in Q2.
Raj (Eng): I'll draft the PRD with detailed requirements, API shapes, acceptance criteria, and experiment matrix. Target: EOD Thursday.
Simon (Data): I'll prototype dashboards and mock queries for event sourcing of pin/unpin.
Tyler (Infra): I'll provide exact mem/cost numbers and a safety limit flag to cap pin count per cluster.
Leah (Program Manager): I'll sync legal + sales and capture PharmCo requirements in contract language.
deploy-bot: Canary window created: 2026-04-02 01:00 UTC -> 2026-04-06 01:00 UTC. Use `/deploy canary 1912345678` to start.
Raj (Eng): Will post PRD link here when ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
